profile_text.body:
MiniMax is a for-profit AI startup founded in early 2022 and headquartered in Shanghai, China. The company describes itself as a global leader in multi-modal foundation models and AI-native products, with a stated mission of advancing toward Artificial General Intelligence. Its site claims a user base of over 200 million. MiniMax says it has independently developed multimodal foundation models capable of processing text, audio, image, video, and music, with features including code generation, agent capabilities, and ultra-long context processing.

Building on those models, MiniMax has released a suite of products including MiniMax Code, MiniMax Hub, MiniMax Audio, and Talkie, along with an open platform for enterprises and developers. The site also hosts Hailuo AI, a video generation product. This site tracks MiniMax under the Chinese Foundation Models and Video Generation categories, and notes that cross-border data review is advised for both its core models and the Hailuo AI video product.

MiniMax is a defendant in a lawsuit filed by Disney Enterprises in the U.S. District Court for the Central District of California, captioned Disney Enterprises, Inc. v. Minimax.
